text: Ex ante remedies for the downsides of representative democracy were not technologically possible when democratic representation was designed, so its downsides such as corruption, bribery, and bias had to be tolerated as inevitable tradeoffs.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Systems Can Upgrade AI (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808867

isBasedOn.name: How Decentralized Systems Can Upgrade AI

abstract: Ex-ante remedies to overcome these downsides of representative democracies were not technologically possible.
